content.value_statement: Backup failures and untested restores can cause long outages. This skill helps plan, create, monitor, and test Proxmox recovery workflows.
actual_capabilities: Create VM and container backup requests.
Restore VMs and containers from existing backups.
Create and restore VM and container snapshots.
Monitor backup status, history, storage usage, and failure rates.
Plan retention policies, RTO, RPO, and disaster recovery tests.
Generate backup, audit, compliance, and recovery reports.
limitations: Requires access to compatible Proxmox backup and restore tools.
Does not guarantee backup integrity without separate verification.
Cannot replace organization-specific recovery governance or approvals.
Restores and deletions can cause data loss if inputs are wrong.

use_cases.title: Run Daily Backup Operations
use_cases.description: Review backup status, storage usage, failures, and retention needs across Proxmox VMs and containers.

use_cases.title: Test Recovery Procedures
use_cases.description: Plan restore tests with snapshots, isolated environments, validation checks, and documented recovery results.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Evidence
use_cases.description: Generate backup reports that show coverage, retention, restore testing, and recovery objectives.

prompt_templates.title: Review Backup Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show recent Proxmox VM and container backups. Include status, age, storage location, and any failed jobs that need attention.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Backup Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a backup plan for these Proxmox workloads: [systems]. Include frequency, retention, storage targets, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Test Recovery Procedure
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a disaster recovery test for VM [id] and container [id]. Include snapshot use, restore checks, rollback criteria, and documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Recovery Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our Proxmox recovery readiness for [environment]. Compare backup coverage, RTO, RPO, retention, storage capacity, and compliance reporting gaps.

output_examples.input: Review recent backups for production VMs.
output: Production VM backups are current for VM 100 and VM 102.
VM 104 has no successful backup in the last 24 hours.
Storage use is nearing the planned retention threshold.

output_examples.input: Plan a recovery test for a customer database VM.
output_examples.output: The plan selects a recent backup, restores it to an isolated test environment, verifies service health, records RTO, and documents rollback steps.

output: Keep daily backups for short-term recovery needs.
Keep weekly backups for audit and rollback coverage.
Review storage growth before enabling longer retention windows.

best_practices: Keep restore tests on a regular schedule and record actual recovery times.
Verify backup integrity before relying on a backup for production recovery.
Use retention rules that match business, storage, and compliance requirements.
anti_patterns: Deleting old backups before confirming newer backups can restore critical services.
Restoring directly into production without an approved rollback plan.
Treating backup success messages as proof that applications are recoverable.

faq.question: Does this skill run backups by itself?
faq.answer: It guides and coordinates backup workflows through compatible Proxmox tools. The environment must provide the actual backup operations.

faq.question: Can it restore a failed VM?
faq.answer: It can help locate a backup and guide VM restore steps when compatible restore tooling is available.

faq.question: Does it verify backup integrity?
faq.answer: It can include verification steps and reports, but integrity depends on tests run against your backup platform.

faq.question: Is it safe to delete backups with this skill?
faq.answer: Backup deletion should require explicit approval, retention checks, and confirmation that newer recoverable backups exist.

faq.question: Can it help with RTO and RPO planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map workloads to recovery time and recovery point targets, then align backup schedules.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
